interpretation.text: Against outcome, s100b_high had a sensitivity of 63.4% (95% CI [46.9, 77.9]) and a specificity of 80.6% [69.5, 88.9] in 113 subjects. The positive likelihood ratio was 3.26 and the negative likelihood ratio 0.45; a positive result is weak evidence for the disease.

title: Diagnostic Test Accuracy
code:
# Diagnostic accuracy of s100b_high against outcome
d <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("s100b_high", "outcome"), drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
d$s100b_high <- factor(d$s100b_high, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
d$outcome <- droplevels(factor(d$outcome))
test_pos <- d$s100b_high == levels(d$s100b_high)[2]
disease <- d$outcome == levels(d$outcome)[2]
tp <- sum(test_pos & disease); fp <- sum(test_pos & !disease)
fn <- sum(!test_pos & disease); tn <- sum(!test_pos & !disease)
n <- tp + fp + fn + tn
# Proportions with exact (Clopper-Pearson) confidence intervals
prop_ci <- function(x, n) c(estimate = x / n, lower = binom.test(x, n, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int[1], upper = binom.test(x, n, conf.level = 0.95)$conf.int[2])
accuracy <- rbind(
  Sensitivity = prop_ci(tp, tp + fn),
  Specificity = prop_ci(tn, tn + fp),
  `Positive predictive value` = prop_ci(tp, tp + fp),
  `Negative predictive value` = prop_ci(tn, tn + fn),
  Accuracy = prop_ci(tp + tn, n),
  Prevalence = prop_ci(tp + fn, n))
sens <- tp / (tp + fn); spec <- tn / (tn + fp)
# Likelihood ratios and diagnostic odds ratio with log-method confidence intervals
z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - 0.95) / 2)
ratio_ci <- function(est, se) c(estimate = est, lower = exp(log(est) - z * se), upper = exp(log(est) + z * se))
ratios <- rbind(
  `Positive likelihood ratio` = ratio_ci(sens / (1 - spec), sqrt(1 / tp - 1 / (tp + fn) + 1 / fp - 1 / (fp + tn))),
  `Negative likelihood ratio` = ratio_ci((1 - sens) / spec, sqrt(1 / fn - 1 / (tp + fn) + 1 / tn - 1 / (fp + tn))),
  `Diagnostic odds ratio` = ratio_ci((tp * tn) / (fp * fn), sqrt(1 / tp + 1 / fp + 1 / fn + 1 / tn)))
youden <- sens + spec - 1
